answer: Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. Forging 345 of these means building 345 separate cultivation histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The defence rests on allotment society membership with plot cultivation history: a plot cultivated under one society for years. Watch the basalt: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the canyon bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the violet audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
